collisionReview.reason: The source identity matches the existing production ASIASTAR YBL6119H Passenger Bus; promotion must not overwrite or duplicate it.

Distinct official pages and images use the same base model and currently carry materially identical dimensions, engine, speed and seating. Evidence is insufficient to promote both as unique identities.
The manufacturer listing repeats the model, but the prepared source contains one identity and one canonical product URL, so it is retained once.
Each suffix set is presented together on one official product page with one specification set and remains one source-backed record; suffixes were not rewritten or split.
